meta.name: storage
meta.description: Storage management for Zephyr RTOS. Covers Non-Volatile Storage (NVS) for persistent settings, flash partition management in Devicetree, and runtime flash layout access. Trigger when implementing persistent data storage, managing flash wear leveling, or configuring device partitions.

copy.tagline: 管理 Zephyr RTOS 的持久化存储和闪存分区
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为 Zephyr RTOS 设备实现持久数据存储。
copy.tagline_en: Manage persistent storage and flash partitions for Zephyr RTOS
copy.fit_line_en: For you if implementing persistent data storage for Zephyr RTOS devices.

howto.what: Claude 能够帮你实现 Zephyr RTOS 上的持久数据存储，包括使用 NVS 进行读写、管理设备树中的 flash 分区以及访问运行时 flash 布局。
howto.when: 当你需要实现持久数据存储、管理 flash 磨损均衡或配置设备分区时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 NVS 保存一个整数配置项。
say.note: Claude 会生成 nvs_write 代码示例。

say.text: 如何在设备树中定义存储分区？
say.note: Claude 会提供固定分区模板。

say.text: 检查 NVS 数据是否持久化。
say.note: Claude 会建议使用 nvs_read 验证。

howto.what_en: Claude helps implement persistent data storage on Zephyr RTOS, including NVS read/write, managing flash partitions in Devicetree, and runtime flash layout access.
howto.when_en: Trigger when implementing persistent data storage, managing flash wear leveling, or configuring device partitions.

say_en.text: Save an integer config item using NVS.
say_en.note: Claude will generate nvs_write code example.

say_en.text: How to define a storage partition in Devicetree?
say_en.note: Claude will provide a fixed-partitions template.

say_en.text: Check if NVS data persists after reset.
